title: Discovery is not evidence
author: Faye Niu
figure_type: conceptual two-lane discovery and evidence-boundary diagram
status: author synthesis; non-empirical; not a result
purpose: Separate LLM-assisted candidate discovery from bounded evidence processing, show source admission before capture, and expose deterministic-first structured extraction plus the bounded optional OpenAI model-assisted route before mandatory deterministic validation, normalisation and independent verification.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: The figure represents repository-specified controls and literature-based rationale for candidate discovery, source admission, controlled capture, explicit extraction routing, deterministic exact-span/schema validation and normalisation, independent verification and supported or non-claim outcomes.
evidence_boundary.lane_boundary: The discovery lane may emit only candidate URLs or identifiers and origin metadata. It has no direct path to a report claim. Candidate-queue membership is not evidence status. After admission and capture, the evidence path explicitly distinguishes deterministic structured extraction from bounded optional model-assisted extraction.
evidence_boundary.untrusted_content_boundary: Retrieved public content remains data, cannot change instructions or permissions, and cannot authorise tools or actions.
excluded_claims: web-search citations, annotations, snippets or source lists as admitted evidence
retrieval or RAG as a guarantee against hallucination
the whole post-queue path as deterministic
concealment of the optional external-model extraction route

generation.determinism_control: ReportLab invariant mode, fixed PDF metadata, core Helvetica fonts, fixed 900-by-1340-point geometry, and no timestamp, randomness or absolute input path embedded in the PDF.
generation.accessibility: The SVG contains a programmatic title and full description. The TXT file supplies the complete linear text alternative. The vector PDF is not claimed to be tagged.

traceability.figure_claim: LLM-assisted retrieval is candidate discovery and remains separate from admission, extraction and verification.
traceability.visible_control: Purple discovery lane terminates at the neutral candidate queue

traceability.figure_claim: Documented Responses API web-search capabilities fit discovery but do not make returned material admitted evidence or prove execution.
traceability.visible_control: Responses API candidate node and source inventory both carry candidate-only status

traceability.figure_claim: Grounded extraction is deterministic-first for structured evidence, exposes a bounded optional OpenAI route for admitted unstructured public or synthetic evidence, and requires both routes to pass deterministic exact-span/schema validation, normalisation and independent verification.
traceability.visible_control: Source admission -> controlled capture -> deterministic structured extraction first OR bounded optional OpenAI extraction with store=False -> deterministic exact-span/schema validation and normalisation -> independent verification

traceability.figure_claim: Retrieved public content remains untrusted data under fixed permissions and fail-closed validation.
traceability.visible_control: Retrieved-content box remains outside the instruction boundary and has no tool/action authority, including on the optional model-assisted route

traceability.figure_claim: Comprehensive discovery is bounded and reports missing, held and conflict states rather than claiming exhaustive coverage or open-web recall.
traceability.visible_control: Explicit missing, held and conflict outputs plus bottom discovery-is-not-evidence boundary

limitations: The diagram is a conceptual design rationale, not an observed workflow-frequency, coverage or outcome model.
The exact lane, state, record-field and gate structure is a project design choice; the cited literature does not establish it as a universal standard.
The captured OpenAI documentation establishes documented features on the access date, not live execution or performance of this artefact.
The post-queue evidence path is not wholly deterministic: the diagram explicitly shows bounded optional OpenAI model-assisted extraction for admitted unstructured public or synthetic evidence.
The optional model route uses store=False and produces only a typed proposal; strict deterministic schema/span validation, normalisation and independent verification remain mandatory.
Retrieval, attribution, citations and source lists do not establish truth or complete grounding.
Prompt-injection containment and independent verification are controls, not evidence of automatic effectiveness or user benefit.
The figure is grounded in frozen local sources and repository contracts; it does not evaluate live public-web operation, comparative performance, human utility or production safety.
The PDF is vector but untagged; use the SVG title/description or complete TXT alternative for accessible reading order.
